Basic chat completion against real OpenAI API

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["maxTokens" => 10, "messages" => [["content" => "Say hello in exactly one word.", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "openai/gpt-4o-mini"]));
$result = LiterLlm::chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getUsage());
```
